column2: How do I choose what a record shows on a board?
column3: Choose the record placed: on the right, “The record shows”: photo, full dates, years, places, occupation, age, parents. Everything is read again from the record each time the board opens: if you correct a date, the card follows.

column2: How do I mark a lead as to check, confirmed or false?
column3: Choose a note: on the right, “Investigation lead” → ❓ To check, ✅ Confirmed or ❌ False. The note takes the colour of its state and a badge. At the top of the board, “❓ n to check” counts the remaining leads: a click takes you to the next one.

column2: How do I put a comment on an item of a board?
column3: Choose the item → “💬 Comment” on the right. Choose a word for the bubble (To check, Question, Idea, Source?, Important…) or “＋ another word…” for your own (it is kept in your list, “My words” to remove some). A small bubble appears on the item; a click on it reopens the comments, which you tick when they are settled.

column2: How do I make areas (frames) on a board?
column3: “＋ Add” → “▭ A frame” (if there is a selection, the frame surrounds it). Give it a name (“Paternal branch”, “Sources to see”): what is entirely inside moves with it. ▾ at the top left folds it (its content is hidden, the number of items stays shown); ▸ unfolds it.

column2: How do I align or distribute several items?
column3: Choose several (⇧ + click or by dragging in empty space): on the right, “Align” (left, centre, right, top, middle, bottom) and “Distribute” (same gap horizontally or vertically, same width, same height). The 🧲 button at the top turns on the snapping grid: while dragging, items snap to the grid and to the edges and middles of the others (pink lines show them); ⌥ / Alt to do without it for a moment.

column2: How do I use the layers of a board?
column3: At the top: 🗂 Layers → “＋ New layer”. The circle chooses the layer where new items go; 👁 shows or hides it (even in exported images), 🔒 locks it (it can no longer be selected), ↑ brings it to the front, ⬚ selects what it contains. “Put the selection on the chosen layer” moves items; on the right, “Layer” too.

column2: How do I search in a board?
column3: At the top: 🔍 (or ⌘F): type a word or a name. It searches the notes, texts, spreadsheets, record names, comments and markers. Click a result (or Enter, ⇧ + Enter to go back): the board goes there and shows it; a folded frame opens, a hidden layer is shown.

column2: How do I get a board’s mini-map?
column3: At the top: 🗺 shows or hides it (also the × on it). The whole board in small, the current view in red: click or drag inside to move around. Drag its title bar to put it where you like: it stays there.

column2: How do I present a board?
column3: At the top: “▶ Present” → “＋ The current view as a step” (zoom and frame first), “＋ The selection as a step” or “＋ One step per frame”. “☰ The steps” to rename them, put them back in order, review them. “▶ Start”: full screen, the board glides from one step to the next (→ or space to go forward, ← to go back, Esc to finish). Without steps, the frames are used as steps.

column2: How do I make an arrow in several segments, one that goes around, or a ready-made “brother of”?
column3: Choose the line: the small “＋” in the middle of each segment can be dragged to bend it (a blue elbow appears; double-click it to remove it). “Line shape” → “⤳ goes around items”: the arrow passes around whatever is in its way. “Ready-made link” (on the right, or in the bar of the Arrow tool before drawing): brother of, sister of, husband of, wife of, father of, daughter of, cousin of, godfather of, witness of, wrote to, same person?… with its caption, colour and style.

column2: What happens when I paste an Excel table or a list onto a board?
column3: Paste (⌘V) onto the board: for several lines, the app asks what it should become: a spreadsheet (for a piece of Excel or Numbers), one note per line, one note per spreadsheet row, or a single text. The notes are arranged in a grid, next to what is already there, and grouped if you like.

column2: How do I make my own board templates?
column3: In a board: “⤓ Export” → “⭐ Make it a template” (the whole board or the selection, with or without the texts). It appears in “New board”, under “My templates”; the × on a template deletes it.

column2: How do I duplicate an item on a board by dragging it (as in Photoshop)?
column3: Hold down ⌥ Option (Mac) or Alt (PC) and drag the item (or the selection): a copy goes with the mouse, the original stays in place. A frame takes along a copy of what it contains. ⌥ + click without dragging copies nothing.

column2: How do I choose a font’s weight (Light, Medium, Bold…) on a board?
column3: Choose the text: on the right, under “Font”, “Weight”. By default, the nine usual weights (Thin 100 to Black 900). Click 🖥 (the computer’s fonts): the list then shows the weights the font really has (e.g. Futura Std: Light, Book, Medium, Heavy…). The B button switches back to normal / bold.

column2: How do I create my own arrowheads?
column3: Settings → Boards → ➤ Arrowheads → “＋ Create an arrowhead”: from a shape (look for it among all the shapes, yours included) or drawn with the pen; rotate it (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°), filled or outlined, attached by the tip, the middle or the back; give it a name. It is added to the list (with a preview of each arrowhead), where you arrange, hide or delete it (🗑). The app also offers 26 arrowheads: triangle (filled or empty), thin or long arrow, double chevron, circle, square, diamond, cross, plus, star, heart, crow’s foot…

column2: How do I set the colours and settings of line captions?
column3: Settings → Boards → 🎨 Colours: three categories “Line captions” (text, frame fill, frame border). → ☰ Menus and options: “Settings of a line caption”: the order of these settings and those to hide (size, font, bold, colours, frame, position, side, distance, angle).

column2: How do I record a voice memo on a board?
column3: “＋ Add” → “🎙 A voice memo” → ⏺ Record, then ⏹ Stop: you can listen to it again, give it a title, then “Place on the board”. The sound is stored with the board and in the app’s media. The first time, the computer asks for access to the microphone.

column2: How do I link a board to a person, an investigation, a part of an investigation…?
column3: Under the title of the board: “🔗 Link…” → a person, an investigation, a search sweep, a Workshop project, a collection, a place (its commune), a media item, a label, a family (a couple), an event, an animal or another board, with, if you like, the name of a part (lead 1, the witnesses…). You can add several; × to remove one. The board then also appears on the person’s record (“Boards” block) and in the linked investigation, search sweep or project. “change” next to where it is filed moves the board itself.

column2: How do I make a free-form board (like Freeform)?
column3: Investigations → “Boards” tab → “＋ New board” (empty, evidence wall, mind map, timeline, hand-drawn tree). Tools at the top: text, note, shapes, line, arrow (it follows what it connects), freehand drawing, eraser; “＋ Add” places a file (image, GIF, sound, video, PDF), a media item from the app, an image or a website from the web, a record, an app screen (with a live preview), one of your widgets, a collection, a label, a folder (a board within the board). Drag or paste images directly. ⌘G group, ⌘L lock, ⌘D duplicate, ⌘Z undo. Everything saves itself.

column2: How do I put a board in an investigation, a search sweep or the Workshop?
column3: In the investigation (or the search sweep, or the project), “🧩 Boards” section → “＋ New board here”. Give it a part (“Lead 1”) to have several. For a board already made: at the top of the board, “change” next to where it is filed.

column2: How do I transcribe a family record book?
column3: Lists → “Family record books” → “＋ New record book”: issue, marriage, husband and wife with their parents, children, annotations, full transcription and photos of the pages. Link each person to their record (or “create the record”); the record book then appears on the record. “Carry over to the records” adds what is missing (births, deaths, marriage, the couple’s children) without overwriting anything.

column2: How do I retouch a photo precisely?
column3: Viewer → Retouch: zoom (⌘ + wheel, + −, 1:1), move around with the space bar. The healing brush and the stamp have a size ([ and ] keys) and a hardness; “🎯 Choose the spot to copy from” for the stamp. Brush (6 kinds) and text go on layers, above the photo. The “History” tab lets you go back to any step.

column2: How do I fill in an employer’s record?
column3: Lists → Employers → “🏢 Create the record” (or click on the employer in a census, or “🏢 This employer’s record” under the Employer field). Identity, head office, managers, establishments, timeline, notes and sources; “Fill from the Annuaire des entreprises” fills in, in one click, a company that exists (or has existed since the 1970s). The record also shows the family who worked there.

column2: In what formats can I save an edited sound?
column3: Sound workshop (✂️ Edit) → Save: MP3 (plays everywhere, quality from 96 to 320 kbit/s), WAV or FLAC (lossless), Ogg Opus (the lightest), AIFF (Mac). You can switch to mono, change the sample rate, and “Only download the file” without changing anything in the database.

column2: How do I add photos or scans?
column3: In the Media block of the record (“＋” button). For a whole folder that fills up by itself (scanner, phone): Settings → Watched “Scans” folder.

column2: How do I brighten or retouch an old photo?
column3: Open the photo, then “🎚️ Retouch”: brightness, contrast, shadows, colours, black and white, sepia, negative and a curve as in Photoshop. “Replace the photo” always keeps the original (“Back to the original”); “Save a copy” adds the retouched version alongside.

column2: How do I request a recent record from the town hall?
column3: Lists → Letter register → “Records to request from the town hall”: the letter is prepared, and a reminder can be set for the day the record becomes public.

column2: How do I arrange the pages of a photographed register or notebook?
column3: Lists → Collections: the pages in order, with their transcription, a cover image, a table per page (to paste from a spreadsheet) and lines linked to the records.

column2: How do I go through a census or a register page by page?
column3: Lists → Surveys: the views of the scan alongside, the people arranged by household with the household’s address, and a padlock 🔒 so that nothing is changed by mistake once the page has been checked.

column2: How do I listen to a recording or cut a video?
column3: Lists → Audio or Videos: player with speed from 0.10× to 6×. “✂️ Edit” opens the sound and video workshop (cut, enhance, assemble); the original is always kept.

column2: How do I combine several photos into a single image?
column3: Lists → Media (or the viewer) → “🧩 Assemble photos”: resize, rotate, set the transparency.

column2: How do I prepare a book, a thesis or an exhibition?
column3: Investigations → Research workshop: projects with nested folders, references imported from Zotero, CSL JSON or EndNote, exports to Word, PDF and CSL JSON.
